entities.summary: The Mohaideen Andavar Mosque, also known as Mohaideen Andavar Jumma Mosque, is a Friday mosque located in Thirukkalachery, Mayiladuthurai district, in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. The mosque is situated in Mosque Street.
